prediction.label: PNEUMONIA
prediction.description: Findings consistent with pneumonia - patchy parenchymal opacity.

findings.name: Mean Intensity
findings.explanation: Average pixel brightness of the radiograph.

findings.name: Lung Opacity
findings.explanation: Fraction of the lung fields showing increased density (consolidation / infiltration).

findings.name: Apical Opacity
findings.explanation: Brightness of the lung apices relative to the lung fields - raised in apical tuberculosis.

findings.name: Perihilar Opacity
findings.explanation: Brightness of the perihilar zones relative to the lung fields - raised with central consolidation.

findings.name: Peripheral Infiltration
findings.explanation: Brightness of the peripheral lower zones relative to the lung fields - typical of COVID-19 pneumonia.

findings.name: Costophrenic Blunting
findings.explanation: Brightness of the costophrenic angles relative to the lung fields - indicates pleural effusion.

findings.name: Symmetry Score
findings.explanation: Left/right similarity of the lung fields - asymmetry suggests unilateral disease.

findings.name: Texture Entropy
findings.explanation: Entropy of the intensity distribution - higher values suggest heterogeneous lung texture.

findings.name: Edge Density
findings.explanation: Density of structural edges - raised with interstitial or focal pathology.

findings.name: Image Quality
findings.explanation: Technical quality of the radiograph (sharpness and contrast).
